title: a4-sa09: Analog Four MKII, OS 1.56 (UNRELEASED)
description: UNRELEASED: the A4 mod 0.9, never run on a real A4. A track's sound can pick a Sidecar machine, whose audio comes back through that voice's analog filters and amp. The same file elekloader builds from core-0.3.elemod + sidecar-a4-0.9.elemod with the lock file and version SA09 (sha256 605ff068...db9e5c). Needs a Sidecar with the A4 pages.
